written.myAnswer: A computer system includes hardware (physical components), software (programs and instructions), data (the information being processed), and users (the people who operate or use it).

Computers process data and perform tasks; software systems provide the programs and instructions that computers use; computer networks connect devices to share data and resources; the Internet is a worldwide network of interconnected networks.
The three requirements are hardware, software, and electricity (power).

The four types are computers, software systems, computer networks, and the Internet. Computers process data; software systems provide instructions and functions; networks connect devices to share information and resources; and the Internet connects networks worldwide for communication and data exchange.
